# NHSOFearlystagecancer

<!-- badges: start -->
<!-- badges: end -->

This R package provides code for calculating the Slope Index of Inequality (SII)
used for the NHS Oversight Framework measure Deprivation gap in early cancer
diagnosis, either for use directly in R, or as an example for translating into
other tools.

## Installation

You can install the development version of NHSOFearlystagecancer from [GitHub/nhsengland/NHSOFearlystagecancer](https://github.com/nhsengland/NHSOFearlystagecancer/) with:

``` r
# install.packages("pak")
pak::pak("nhsengland/NHSOFearlystagecancer")
```

## Example

Given some early diagnosis data by deprivation quintile

```{r example}
library(NHSOFearlystagecancer)

example_df <- data.frame(
  date = rep(as.Date("2026-02-01"), 5),
  org_code = rep("ABC", 5),
  deprivation = c("1 - most deprived", "2", "3", "4", "5 - least deprived"),
  ed_prop = c(0.55, 0.58, 0.595, 0.606, 0.619),
  ed_denom = c(39546, 43663, 48796, 51117, 50739)
)

knitr::kable(example_df)
```

We can get the SII with `derive_sii()`

```{r derive_sii}
example_result <- example_df |> 
  derive_sii(
    by = c("date", "org_code"),
    ed_prop_col = "ed_prop",
    ed_denom_col = "ed_denom",
    depr_col = "deprivation"
)

example_result[, c("org_code", "sii")]
```

Note we are working with early diagnosis proportion on the scale of 0 to 1, so
in this case we see an 8.04 percentage point difference between in the
proportion between the most and least deprived groups. That is our deprivation
gap.

We can also score the
provided data with `score_sii()`. Scoring is done by comparison to the mean SII,
and here because we have only one set of values, the result falls in group 3 for
"_No evidence for a smaller-than-average deprivation gap_".

```{r}
example_result <- score_sii(example_result, by = "date")

example_result[, c("org_code", "sii", "sii_score")]
```

## Code for recreating elsewhere

You can view the code for the core functionality here:

- [derive_sii()](https://github.com/nhsengland/NHSOFearlystagecancer/blob/main/R/derive_sii.R) 
  derive the SII across all groups in the provided data.
  
- [fit_sii()](https://github.com/nhsengland/NHSOFearlystagecancer/blob/main/R/fit_sii.R) 
  the individual fitting of the regression model.
  
- [score_sii()](https://github.com/nhsengland/NHSOFearlystagecancer/blob/main/R/score_sii.R)
  compare the SII to the mean SII to assign the scoring group.

The documentation of `lm()` may also be useful for explaining the implementation
of regression by weighted least squares.

## Further examples

There is also a helper for visualising the fit of the model: `plot_sii()`

```{r}
example_result <- plot_sii(example_result, id = "org_code")

example_result$plot[[1]]
```

See `vignette("explain-SII")` for an explanation of the SII and scoring, as well
as applying the function across many ICBs.
